facts.fact: The presentation says NCLAS 1 was rolled out to all Communal Land Boards in 2008 and web-based, server-based NCLAS 2 was introduced in 2014 by the ministry, to register customary and leasehold rights in communal areas.
The presentation says NCLAS has two components, communal deeds and communal cadastre (parcel geometries), linked via a Unique Parcel Identifier.

systems.owner: Ministry of Agriculture, Water and Land Reform

note: The document reports only a workshop agreeing to craft a plan to digitise property acquisition; no system delivered.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water and Land Reform said that since 2003 it had run manual and automated (Computerized Deeds Registration System) systems in parallel, and on 20 July 2022 the automated system was offline after a malfunction.
